name: Konno Tsukasa
source:
Tsukasa is the son and only-child of the president of the large Konno business conglomerate. One day when his parents were gone he was kidnapped, and is now kept confined in the bomb shelter in the forest behind the school, being used as a sex object by his kidnappers.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/kioku/kioku.php]Boys' Love Game Headquarters[/url]]
